summary.text: Jenn O'Mara, listed by Ballotpedia as Jennifer O'Mara, is a Democratic state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 165 since December 1, 2018 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Jenn O'Mara's Ballotpedia profile lists a bachelor's degree from West Chester University and a graduate degree from the University of Pennsylvania.
She took office in December 2018, succeeding Republican Alexander Charlton.

In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the House Labor and Industry Committee, where she chaired the subcommittee on employment and unemployment compensation, and to the Transportation and Veterans Affairs and Emergency Preparedness committees.
